system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: National scope covering Canada's entire 650 Mha forested ecosystem with wall-to-wall wildfire characterization.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Annual forest wildfire disturbance from 1985 to 2020 (36 years).
data_description.records: Multi-band image with annual wildfire years
data_description.data_type_numeric: Year of wildfire disturbance per pixel
data_description.total_samples: 30-meter pixels covering 650 Mha of Canadian forests

bands.name: wildfire_year
bands.description: Year of stand-replacing wildfire disturbance detection (1985-2020)

data_description.important_note: This dataset represents 36 years of wildfire change over Canada's forests derived from Landsat time series using the Tracking Intra- and Inter-year Change algorithm. It provides a consistent, spatially explicit characterization of stand-replacing forest disturbances caused by wildfire at national scale.

unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Extract the wildfire_year band to identify when each pixel experienced stand-replacing fire; no-data values indicate no detected wildfire during the period.

data_description.data_source: Hermosilla et al. 2016 via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
